received_works.body:
Hello again! I have another dragon! Can I please request you draw my dragon Moonwhisper with his six black wings and tail? I have put his design into a google drive and a pose idea. I would love to see him flying at night. Thank you for considering my request!
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1mRYbut54pw7vU_fyz-2k_XYSjlys7QRG

Hello! I love your art of dragons and other monsters a bunch! I would love if you could draw my dragon, Aurex, in a relaxed pose, stretching his wings and yawning! He is quite big and soft...

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Oy580sEizUJes4q3tbOsmY2jEFj0OMGu/view?usp=drivesdk

Hi Yatori Hizaki, good evening, idoa!

I've seen some illustrations of winged people in the past and I've wanted to make a request, so I'm going to take this good opportunity of skeb campaign to make a request!

I am Kissa, an original character, and the character data can be found below.
https://imgur.com/a/m669S2N

As for the subject, I've been wondering about the "dress this with my child" meme that's been going around in the foreign animal community lately, so I'm asking for Kissa-chan and the dress in the example!
https://twitter.com/MissAmethysa/status/1765481511753511308

As for the pose, I think it emphasizes the open area next to the waist and Kissa-chan's just white/blue pattern, so I'll leave the pose up to you as long as you don't hide the waist! (I know the legs won't be in a very active position due to the way the dress is made)

Nice to meet you.
I need an illustration of Devilon the Black Dragon. I will leave the detailed composition etc. to you.

Thank you in advance for your time.

References
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lIqliMxlO0jZ0LO6XUmzujgF3_6NG5bW

Hello! I love your dragon art!! Can I please request you draw my dragon Odin with his Prince Thane? I have put their designs into a google drive and some pose ideas. I would love to see Odin protecting Thane. Thank you for considering my request!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1UOL5V21rAa2AxOgA4IDAyqsj37xVhqeJ?usp=drive_link

Hello 氷咲 やとり! I love your style! Would you please draw my dragon character? I'm happy to leave all the details to you. Thank you very much!

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1BKmHO8Po6MiKQmueFMZcPNbkI1b0Wps2/view

Good evening, Yatori-san!
I am Shiranui Nui, the artist who drew the dragon figure for me a long time ago. Thank you for your help on that occasion ✨
I would like to request you to draw me as a dragon again, since I loved it so much last time!

I am an original character of a creature called "Kaiju," which can be used anywhere in the water, on land, and in the air...but it can also transform into a dragon form through magic. It can also magically transform into a dragon... or something like that.

Brief additional explanation of the design
The braids are white with light blue mesh.
The wings and hands are not attached to the body.
The hands are of the type where the nails and fingers are integrated.

Uses, etc.
I would like to use it as a thumbnail on YouTube and on social networking sites such as X. I would be happy to depict the whole body if possible!
I would appreciate it if you could depict the whole body if possible.
I would appreciate it if you could give me a transparent PNG without the background.
We will leave the facial expressions and composition to you! I would be happy if you could draw it in a way that makes it easy for me to draw.

I love Yatori's wings and eyes! I love your wings and eyes! I am very much in awe of your work... I will continue to support you in the future! Thank you so much!

Reference →.
https://x.com/siraai_nui/status/1742881184596533315?s=46&t=y3CzxCVnaKHbeX804SKOiQ

1st photo: Atmosphere of the face
2nd photo: Atmosphere of the whole body
3rd: Top view & atmosphere of the eyes
4th - the original image (for color reference)
5th: A dragon drawn to look like the original (for reference only)

You can ignore the color and shape of the wings. I apologize for the fluff... but if it's OK with you, I'd appreciate it if you could help me!

Hello! I love your dragon artworks! Can I please request your draw my dragon Endri with Princess Natasha?
I have put their designs into a google drive, and I have also put in some posing reference. I would love to see Endri flying in the sky, with the princess below her.
I hope you will accept, but will understand if the request is too difficult. Thank you for your time

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1eMAQ9gbwCuuYW6ZFvOWUFv6NZ3RkxeAA?usp=sharing

Thank you very much for all your help.
I really like the dragons and dragons drawn by Yatori-san, so if you don't mind, I would like to ask you to draw my creative characters Yurig, Rai, and Ruze.
Please refer to the URL for materials.

These dragons are brothers and they are very close to the girl and they walk, shop, eat, climb and camp together.
Yurig also cares for Rae as if she were his sister, so when Rae is about to be attacked by thugs, Yurig sometimes takes a stand to protect her.
Ruze has a sense of justice, but she is still small, so in such cases she leaves them alone and runs away.
However, although they get along well with each other, they sometimes compete with each other for a delicious meal.

(In my original setting, minors are not allowed to ride on dragons without an adult, but they can fly in secret if it's just a short walk.)
(The shape of Eurig's horns is different from my cartoon, but you can adapt it to the shape of the material.)

I will leave the situation and composition to you. We would appreciate it if you could freely use your imagination within the range of the amount and draw an illustration that shows how they seem to be getting along with each other.
It is also fine if they look like they are fighting with each other.
We are open to heartwarming and gag flavored illustrations.

Thank you in advance for your consideration.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1l_-G5NhS1Qm0SUC5J0OyjBnjeSxcRq3k?usp=drive_link

いつもイラストを拝見させていただいております。
氷咲やとり様の絵柄で是非うちの子のブラドを描いていただきたくリクエストいたします。
服装、構図、ポーズなどはお任せします。
設定としては以下の通り。

・王族(側室の子)、竜と獅子魔獣のハーフ。
・10代後半。獣人姿で170-180cmほど。獣姿だとライオンを一回り大きくした程度。
・自信溢れる俺様系だが内面は常識人タイプ。
・武者修行と称し世界各地を冒険者や傭兵の真似事をして旅している。

よろしくお願いします。

https://www.dropbox.com/sh/g4h5nuzs4qzfh47/AAD6g-n554JuiSogX8enVOTra?dl=0

Hi, 

Was hoping to see you draw my dragon OC, William, again.   The fanart you did years ago was amazing, I’d love to see you try it again with the updated design.  

His 100% dragon form would be best.  A mostly full body image is preferable.  Posing is up to you, but I’d love to see him with a serious or fierce expression.   

My best ref is provided in the URL,  hope it works for you. 

Hope you’ll consider my request.
Thankyou. 
Looking forward to it.  

:B

https://x.com/DrawsPig/status/1669900850645569536?s=20

We have been waiting for you for a long time!

Please draw Yuichiro Fujifuka.
We do not specify the pose, clothing, composition, or situation. We leave it to your imagination.

Reference
https://x.com/s039aka8s/status/1717525485599822051?s=46&t=QvbJnt0z2J5REZ2QopfefQ

Skebの開設をおめでとうございます！
貴方の手掛けられたとても美しくて可愛らしい魅力的なドラゴン達をいつも拝見していました、良ければぜひ、うちの子のドラゴンを手掛けて頂きたくてリクエストをお送りさせて頂きました！

エリクシルという、頭から後ろ脚まで30mくらいある大人のお姉さんなドラゴンになります。
この子をぜひ貴方の手で手掛けて頂けませんか？
構図やポーズなどはお任せ出来ますと嬉しいですが、全身が見えるようなスタイルだととても嬉しいです！

なにとぞご検討をよろしくお願い申し上げます。

ご参考
https://x.com/Haku17/status/1685236847876755456

ご参考その2

https://x.com/Haku17/status/1685237653401427968

sent_works.body:
skebの開設おめでとうございます！
うちの子のギルバートと、できればヴァリというグリフォンのキャラを描いて頂きたいです。(金額に見合わないなと思ったらグリフォンの方は大丈夫です。)2人は相棒のような関係で、性格などはある程度資料に書いてあります。
ポーズや構図、シチュエーションは龖さんにお任せします。よろしくお願いします。

https://x.com/ahogeozisan/status/1722932610777981237?s=61&t=s944EO_SXe7svltVmeNwTA

ずっとお待ちしておりました！良ければ弐敷さんの絵柄でうちの子のルイスさんを見てみたいです。
彼はプライドが高くナルシストで常に自分が1番でないと気が済まないような性格をしています。(詳細は資料の方にもっと詳しく書いてあります。)年齢は46歳となっていますが、魔法のような力で見た目をいじっているため年齢よりだいぶ若く見えます。
ポーズや構図は弐敷さんにお任せします。よろしくお願いいたします。

https://x.com/ahogeozisan/status/1723587257201033492?s=46&t=MaEO5eyI6zqeMxBhSVj14w

こんにちは！うちの子を描いていただきたいです！

彼は堕天使で、喧嘩っ早くどこか適当で不良のようなイメージですがちょっかいをかけるのが大好きだったり仲間思いだったりするような一面もあります。
翼は3対ありますが上位の位の天使という訳ではないです。

シチュエーションはお任せしますが、咲丸さんの描く翼が好きなので出来れば翼を広げた絵が見たいのと、周りにカワラバトを飛ばしていただけると嬉しいです！よろしくお願いいたします。

https://x.com/Yakitori_echa/status/1717493945897451587?s=20

咲丸さんの絵柄で18歳のアレンさんが見たいです！詳細は添付した資料の通りですが基本的に好きに描いていただいて構いません。
それと資料に描き忘れていたのですが、髪の毛は濡羽色で描いたり、内側を青みがかった色で描くことが多いです。
よろしくお願いいたします！

https://twitter.com/allenlesialove/status/1517537736387088385?s=21&t=-y9B2H5f_EJwdQgNKPcRLQ
